manualReview.scope: Model/editor quality-v2 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0075; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Quality-v2 remediation rechecked learner-facing English, removed known weak/teacher-directive patterns where present, and kept the bounded target pragmatically licensed by its prompt.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: مکان/جای خوب preserve the selected location sense rather than a social position or abstract role.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The Lesson introduces one location noun with familiar be and good.

distractorQuality.evidence: Placeholder/generic distractors were removed where present; choices use contrastive alternatives with distinct teaching feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The scene and adjacent turns were checked again so character prompts function as dialogue rather than teacher commands.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances remain short, reuse established A1 language, and add only the bounded target planned for this Lesson.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The library arc returns five Lessons after 0070 and rotates the learner role from Liam to Leo.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner shifts from this location to that location while retaining the target noun sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities, retrieval task, and stated outcome all point to the same bounded learning goal.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; boredom, perceived difficulty and retention remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
